text.history: 抗生素的發現歷史——一次意外的觀察
text.historyCaption: 備註：弗萊明當年的研究對象是葡萄球菌，並非 MRSA；MRSA 首次正式報告於 1961 年。
text.historyCopy: 1928 年，弗萊明在培養葡萄球菌時，觀察到部分培養皿受到青黴菌污染，這種真菌附近的細菌生長受到影響。他進一步研究青黴菌產生的抗菌物質。後來，弗洛里、錢恩及其團隊推進了青黴素（抗生素）的治療應用。

labels.hypothesisApply: 另一情境：對另一種細菌比較未知樣本 U 與相同載體對照。寫一個可用「有無外圍清晰區及總直徑」檢驗的假說；不是重新猜本次 X/Y/Z 的結果。
labels.hypothesisHint: 提示：指出比較條件與可觀察結果；清晰區資料不能直接證明「全部死亡」。
labels.controlPrompt: C 是甚麼？說明它如何提供比較基準，以及為何其餘條件須相同。

concepts: 抗生素主要用於細菌感染，不能治療病毒引起的傷風或流感。
抗生素由紙碟向外擴散，濃度通常隨距離下降；仍足以抑制生長的範圍形成清晰區。較敏感的細菌可在較低濃度下受抑制，清晰區可能較大。
清晰區是沒有可見細菌生長的區域；不能證明全部細菌已死亡。清晰區大小亦受擴散及製備等因素影響，最大區不等於最佳患者治療。
MRSA 對甲氧西林有抗性，不代表對所有抗生素均有抗性。無區不等於本模型已作臨床抗藥判定；模型無臨床判定界線，不能推廣至所有 MRSA。
若原有少量抗性細菌，抗生素的選擇壓力使它們較易存活、繁殖並遺傳抗性特徵。其比例可能上升，抗生素效果可能下降；不必完全佔據群體。
細菌不是為了適應而主動產生需要的抗性，也不是患者本人產生抗性。不當或過度使用抗生素會增加不必要的選擇壓力。

examples.hypothesis: 示例：對細菌 T，比較樣本 P 與相同載體對照，提出「在其他條件相同時，P 紙碟的外圍清晰區總直徑大於載體對照」。這有比較條件及可量度結果，但不能由圈大小證明全部死亡。它不是 X/Y/Z 的預測。
examples.variables: 示例：若只改同一樣本的紙碟大小，獨立變量是紙碟大小；因變量是有無外圍圈及總直徑。要保留相同細菌、載體等條件。本次 X/Y/Z 的練習要按其實際改變因素分類。
examples.control: C 只含相同載體，不含抗生素，用作比較基準。只有載體確為水時才稱水對照。留足紙碟間距及與邊緣的距離，避免區域重疊或難以判讀。
examples.measurement: 示例 S（不是 X/Y/Z/C）：6 mm 紙碟外有清晰區。左端讀 12 mm、右端讀 28 mm；總直徑＝28−12＝16 mm，包括紙碟。若只有紙碟而沒有外圍圈，按本模型記 0，不記 6。
examples.mean: 示例 S 的三塊獨立平板讀數是 12、16、20 mm：平均＝(12+16+20)÷3＝16.0 mm。重複可檢查變異；差異大時先查塗布、污染、紙碟位置及條件，不刪去不合假說的資料。三次是本課安排，不是唯一可靠次數。

rubric.title: 初步觀察
rubric.criterion: 描述真菌附近可見生長較少／有清晰區，分開觀察及原因推測。各1分。

rubric.title: 假說評估
rubric.criterion: 選乙並指出比較條件及可觀察結果；合理理由1分。

rubric.criterion: 另一細菌及 U／載體的可測試比較1分；有無區／直徑結果1分。不按猜中結果評。

rubric.criterion: 獨立1、因1；五項控制各0.4，誤選不適當控制項時該欄0。

rubric.title: 對照解釋
rubric.criterion: 同載體而無抗生素1分；排除載體等因素並維持相同條件1分。不是必然水對照。

rubric.criterion: 方案乙及新平板獨立性1；變異比較1；三次非唯一並提出資源／時間可行性1。

teacherSteps: 實驗組使用 IBL＋VL；比較組沒有課前講授、不操作 VL，只靠本 WS 自學。A 從開始即可閱讀，按「解說→示例→有提示練習→獨立應用→核對修正」進行。
兩組均安排 15–20 分鐘，建議使用相同 20 分鐘總時限：概念 3、示例 2、有提示練習 4、獨立應用 8、核對修正 3 分鐘。15 分鐘課節亦須兩組使用相同總時限，不按速度給能力分。

B1–2 提供提示，B3–5 有十二項獨立量度，B6 是平均值及六類分析，B7 是抗性選擇應用。容許短句或關鍵詞，兩行是作答空間，不要求填滿。
學生完成 B 後固定並保留首次作答，才派 C 核對修正。教師此時才提供答案及針對性回饋。尚未完成者不可先看答案；記錄未完成項目，試教檢查 15–20 分鐘是否足夠，不聲稱軟體測試證實教學完成時間。
所有圖及量尺由現有固定 seeds 1001、1002、1003 與 generateResult 產生。VL 的個別種子不同，不能聲稱每次學生 VL 數字相同。30°C、24 小時是模擬條件；本冊沒有實體 MRSA 培養要求。
以模型直徑 ±1 mm 核對有區量度；沒有外圍清晰區須選無並記 0。平均值按學生自己的三次讀數核對（±0.1 mm），避免把同一量度錯誤再扣一次。
WS 38 分只作此版本的作業檢核，不與 VL 23 分直接比較，也不把紙本程序／讀圖當作實作能力。研究成效另用共同 SPSAI／CKT；正式工具及其效度須研究者核對。

concepts: Antibiotics（抗生素） mainly treat bacterial infections, not viral colds or influenza.

Antibiotic（抗生素） diffuses outward from the disc, usually decreasing in concentration with distance. A clear zone（清晰區） forms where growth is still inhibited（抑制）. More susceptible（對抗生素敏感的） bacteria may be inhibited（抑制） at a lower concentration, allowing a larger zone.
A clear zone（清晰區） has no visible bacterial growth; it does not prove all bacteria died. Diffusion and preparation also affect size, so the largest zone is not the best patient treatment.

MRSA（耐甲氧西林金黃葡萄球菌） resists methicillin（甲氧西林）, not necessarily every antibiotic（抗生素）. No zone is not a clinical resistance（抗藥性） classification: this model has no clinical breakpoints and cannot be generalised to all MRSA（耐甲氧西林金黃葡萄球菌）.

If a few resistant（具抗藥性的） bacteria already exist, antibiotic（抗生素） selection pressure（選擇壓力） favours their survival, reproduction（繁殖） and inheritance（遺傳） of resistance traits（抗藥性特徵）. Their proportion may rise and effectiveness may decline without their occupying the entire population.

Bacteria do not purposefully produce the resistance（抗藥性） they need to adapt, and patients themselves do not develop bacterial resistance（抗藥性）. Misuse（不當使用） or overuse（過度使用） adds unnecessary selection pressure（選擇壓力）.

The sample has eliminated viruses on the agar plate（瓊脂板）.

questions.text: What does the diameter of a clear zone（清晰區） represent?

choices.text: The exact number of bacteria remaining on the plate.
Its effectiveness in patients; the largest diameter identifies the best treatment.
The extent of the area with no visible bacterial growth under these conditions; diffusion and other factors also affect the diameter.
The antibiotic（抗生素） dose a patient should receive.

questions.text: Why do experiments need to be repeated?

choices.text: To ensure that every experiment produces exactly identical absolute values, with no variation whatsoever.
To prolong the experiment so scientists have more to describe when writing their reports.
To reduce random error and assess the reproducibility（可重複性） of the results and the reliability（可靠性） of the data.
To make biological samples rapidly mutate and develop entirely new traits through repeated procedures.

questions.text: If repeated results differ greatly, what should you do, and why?

choices.text: Delete results that disagree with the original hypothesis so the results match.
Keep only the largest reading because it best represents inhibition（抑制）.
Calculate the mean immediately because averaging removes all procedural problems.
First check spreading, disc positions and plate conditions, then repeat as needed to identify causes of variation and improve the comparison.

questions.text: When comparing the clear zones（清晰區） around C (control) and X, Y and Z, what is the main role of C?

choices.text: Ensure that all discs have clear zones（清晰區） of the same diameter.
Identify the best antibiotic（抗生素） for a patient.
Provide an antibiotic（抗生素）-free comparison to help assess whether clear-zone（清晰區） formation is associated with the antibiotic（抗生素） sample.
Increase the amount of sample in the X, Y and Z discs to increase the accuracy（準確度） of the experimental results.

reference.observation: A clear zone（清晰區） with no visible bacterial growth is present near Penicillium（青黴菌） (a fungus). This is an observation; its cause needs testing.
reference.control: Use a matching carrier-only disc without antibiotic（抗生素） to check carrier/disc effects, with other conditions the same. Call it a water control only if every carrier is water.
reference.reflection: Use readings for your chosen sample to support growth inhibition（抑制）. Explain how pre-existing resistance（抗藥性） affects survival and reproduction（繁殖）, how resistance traits（抗藥性特徵） are inherited（遺傳）, and how the resistant（具抗藥性的） proportion increases as antibiotic（抗生素） effectiveness declines. This is a hypothetical extension, not evidence that resistance（抗藥性） arose in this experiment.

teacherSteps: The experimental group uses IBL + VL. The comparison group has no pre-lesson lecture and does not operate the VL; it learns through the WS. Make A available from the start: explanation → example → guided practice → independent application → checking/correction.

Both groups use 15–20 minutes, preferably the same 20-minute limit: concepts 3, examples 2, guided practice 4, independent application 8, checking/correction 3 minutes. If using 15 minutes, use the same limit for both groups; speed is not an ability score.

Teachers may briefly clarify terms, diagram-reading instructions and response requirements already written in the WS, without a separate concept lecture before self-study. Examples do not use X/Y/Z/C outcomes. Do not reveal B answers before completion. Record additional prompts and actual completion times.

B1–2 are guided; B3–5 contain twelve independent measurements; B6 covers means and six analysis categories; B7 applies resistance（抗藥性） selection. Accept short sentences or key terms. Two lines provide space; they need not be filled.

After B is completed, preserve the first answers before distributing C for corrections. Only then provide answers and focused feedback. Do not give answers to unfinished students. Record unfinished items and pilot feasibility of 15–20 minutes; software tests do not establish actual learning duration.

All diagrams and rulers use existing fixed seeds 1001, 1002 and 1003 with generateResult. Individual VL seeds differ; do not claim all learner values are identical. 30°C and 24 hours are simulation conditions. No physical MRSA（耐甲氧西林金黃葡萄球菌） culture is required.

Check external-zone measurements within ±1 mm of the model. Absence requires No and exactly 0. Check means against the student’s own readings (±0.1 mm), avoiding a second penalty for one measurement error.

The 38-mark WS check is specific to this task version, not directly comparable with the VL’s 23 marks; paper ordering/reading is not practical performance. Use common SPSAI/CKT assessments for study outcomes; researchers must verify the formal instruments and their validity.
